expected.question: Which order should I allocate?
expected.help: Choose an existing order below, or reply with its ID, for example ORD-045.

expected.question: More than one order was mentioned.
expected.help: Choose one order for this request. Start a separate request for another order.

expected.question: Should I prioritize cost, speed, or quality?
expected.help: Choose one objective below. For example, select Lowest cost.

expected.question: Which objective should replace the one you rejected?
expected.help: Choose an objective below.

expected.question: What is the exact due date?
expected.help: Use YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-04-08. It must match the registered order; this desk does not edit the order register.

expected.question: The date is not valid.
expected.help: Enter a valid calendar date in the details form.

expected.question: How many workshops may share this order?
expected.help: Set a single maximum, from 1 to 8, below.

expected.question: The preferred workshop is also excluded.
expected.help: Clear the preference or remove that workshop from exclusions.

expected.question: An excluded workshop ID is not in the register.
expected.help: Select exclusions from the workshop list below.

expected.question: The preferred workshop is not in the register.
expected.help: Select a registered workshop or choose Any eligible workshop.

expected.question: I cannot identify the workshop name.
expected.help: Select its exact name in the details form.

expected.question: Should this workshop be used or excluded?
expected.help: Set Preferred workshop or Excluded workshops below.

expected.question: Only one preferred workshop can be specified.
expected.help: Choose one, or clear the preference and allow multiple workshops.

expected.question: That order is not in the register.
expected.help: Start a new request and select an existing order. Creating new business orders is not supported here.

expected.question: I could not apply this update in the current mode.
expected.help: Your previous requirements are retained. Use Edit details below, or replace the full request. Offline shortcuts include: cheapest; use two workshops; exclude W3.

expected.question: This requirement is not supported by the allocator.
expected.help: Budget caps, exact split ratios and minimum quantities are not supported. Replace the full request with supported requirements, or handle the order manually.

expected.question: What would you like to change?
expected.help: Edit the objective, exclusions or workshop limit, then review the new recommendation.

expected.question: This request already belongs to another order.
expected.help: Use New request to allocate a different order.

expected.question: The order changed after your review.
expected.help: Apply your requirements again to load a fresh recommendation before approving.

expected.question: No eligible plan can meet the required deadline.
expected.help: If late delivery is acceptable, turn off Hard deadline; otherwise arrange the order manually.

expected.question: The allowed workshops cannot fit all remaining pieces.
expected.help: Increase Maximum workshops or review your exclusions. Batch limits still apply.

expected.question: No workshop meets all requirements.
expected.help: Review your exclusions and preference below, and open Calculation & eligibility details for the rejection reasons.

expected.question: I could not interpret this as an allocation request.
expected.help: Use an existing order and allocation requirements, for example: Allocate ORD-045 at the lowest cost. Use Production for cancellation or completion.

expected.question: The pieces in your request does not match the order register.
expected.help: Registered value: 100. Select Use registered order details below, or start a new request for the correct order.

expected.question: This order cannot be allocated again.
expected.help: Use Production for existing allocations, or start a new request for a Ready or Unassigned order.

expected.question: The requested workshop W7 cannot take this order: status suspended.
expected.help: Choose another Preferred workshop or select Any eligible workshop. A preferred workshop must take the full remaining batch; increase the workshop limit only after clearing the preference.

expected.question: I still need a clarification: unknown blocker.
expected.help: Edit the relevant field below. If this requirement cannot be expressed there, replace the full request with one clear allocation instruction.

expected.question: The AI service could not process this message.
expected.help: The server has no API key. Configure the provider environment variable locally and restart, or use Edit details without AI.

expected.question: The AI service could not process this message.
expected.help: The provider rejected the server credentials. Check the API key locally, or use Edit details without AI.

expected.question: The AI service could not process this message.
expected.help: The provider account has insufficient balance. Check the account locally, or use Edit details without AI.

expected.question: The AI service could not process this message.
expected.help: The model service is unavailable or returned an invalid response. Retry your text, or use Edit details without AI. No extra order information is required for this error.
